steps.note: Start the RFQ event creation flow.
Enable price-cap validation for the tenant.
Configure the event with an RFQ stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the single line on which the cap will apply.
Invite one QA vendor for the vendor-portal bid.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the published RFQ participants list to configure the vendor cap.
Set the buyer's price cap to 100 for the first invited vendor.
Verify that the cap was saved as 100.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open this live RFQ from the vendor event list at its pricing sheet.
